name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.singletonsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Two scenes demonstrating MonoSingleton: the OnCreate/OnStart/OnRelease lifecycle, GetInstance/InitInstance access, dontDestroyOnLoad persistence across scene loads, and DestroyInstance.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the SingletonSystem: MonoSingleton lifecycle and access patterns, NewSingleton, and DontDestroyOnLoad control. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
